parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: The opener is the front tilting panel of the trashcan, made of durable plastic, typically rectangular in shape and attached via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the trashcan to deposit waste easily. The handle or knob provides a grip point for operation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a lower hinge axis, tilting outward when pulled and returning to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural enclosure of the trashcan, made of wood, providing stability and housing for the internal bin.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the opener and contains the waste compartment, ensuring the trashcan remains upright and stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed frame for the opener mechanism.
